# Fleet Monitor

CS 3660 Web Design 2 — Sprint 2  
Ethan Kidd | UVU | Summer 2026  
Demo day: June 29, 2026

**Live demo:** https://excavator-hatless-boozy.ngrok-free.dev

A distributed fleet telemetry monitoring and alerting system. Simulated vehicles publish sensor readings over MQTT. A gateway pipeline translates, routes, and enriches each reading. An alert engine runs an XState v5 state machine per monitored channel. Every domain event is appended to an immutable, hash-chained SQLite event store. A live browser dashboard shows fleet state in real time with a time-travel slider for point-in-time historical reconstruction.

---

## Architecture

Each component is a separate Node.js process. They share nothing except the MQTT broker and the SQLite event store file.

| Component | Role | Subscribes | Publishes |
|---|---|---|---|
| `device-sim` | Emits raw sensor readings for 3 vehicles | (none) | `fleet/{vehicleId}/raw` |
| `gateway` | Translate, route, and enrich raw readings | `fleet/+/raw` | `fleet/{vehicleId}/{metric}/clean` |
| `alert-engine` | XState machine per channel; decides alert state | `fleet/+/+/clean` | `alerts/{vehicleId}/{metric}` |
| `audit-logger` | Appends every domain event to the event store | `fleet/#`, `alerts/#` | (to SQLite) |
| `ws-bridge` | Koa service: bridges MQTT to browser; serves dashboard and history API | `alerts/#`, `fleet/#` | (to browsers via wss) |
| `dashboard` | Lit Element SPA: live readings, alert states, time-travel slider, ACK/RESOLVE | (via ws-bridge) | ACK / RESOLVE commands |

## Pattern Index

All six patterns are implemented as the named classes below. Pattern names match the auto-grader.

| Pattern | Type | Class / File | Citation |
|---|---|---|---|
| Publish-Subscribe Channel | EIP | `src/bus/mqttBus.js` + all subscribers | https://www.enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/patterns/messaging/PublishSubscribeChannel.html |
| Message Router (Content-Based Router) | EIP | `src/gateway/MessageRouter.js` | https://www.enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/patterns/messaging/ContentBasedRouter.html |
| Content Enricher | EIP | `src/gateway/ContentEnricher.js` | https://www.enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/patterns/messaging/DataEnricher.html |
| Message Translator | EIP | `src/gateway/MessageTranslator.js` | https://www.enterpriseintegrationpatterns.com/patterns/messaging/MessageTranslator.html |
| Strategy | GoF | `src/alert-engine/strategies/` + `StrategyFactory.js` | Gamma et al., *Design Patterns*, 1994 |
| Observer | GoF | `src/events/EventDispatcher.js` + `AuditLogger.js` + `WsBridgeObserver.js` | Gamma et al., *Design Patterns*, 1994 |

### EIP pipeline (gateway)

Raw MQTT reading arrives on `fleet/{vehicleId}/raw`.

1. **Message Translator** (`MessageTranslator.js`) — validates required fields, normalizes casing, adds `receivedAt` and a `raw` snapshot field. Rejects malformed messages.
2. **Message Router / Content-Based Router** (`MessageRouter.js`) — inspects `message.metric` and resolves the output topic template (`fleet/{vehicleId}/{metric}/clean`) without modifying the message itself.
3. **Content Enricher** (`ContentEnricher.js`) — adds vehicle metadata (make, model, year, region), threshold config, rolling average, and a calibration-offset correction. Downstream consumers receive a fully self-describing message.

### GoF patterns

**Strategy** (`src/alert-engine/strategies/`) — `StrategyFactory.js` selects a concrete strategy at runtime based on `metric`:
- `ThresholdStrategy` — simple hi/lo threshold check.
- `RollingAverageStrategy` — uses the rolling mean from ContentEnricher.
- `RateOfChangeStrategy` — fires when the per-reading delta exceeds a configured limit.

**Observer** (`src/events/EventDispatcher.js`) — a lightweight pub/sub hub with `subscribe(eventType, fn)` and `dispatch(eventType, payload)`. Two observers are registered on startup:
- `AuditLogger` — appends every event to the SQLite event store.
- `WsBridgeObserver` — forwards events to all connected WebSocket clients.

## State chart: alert lifecycle

One XState v5 machine instance per monitored channel (e.g., `vehicle-7:coolantTemp`). Defined in `src/alert-engine/alertMachine.js`.

### States

| State | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `NORMAL` | Readings within bounds |
| `WARNING` | Crossed warning threshold, sustained |
| `CRITICAL` | Crossed critical threshold, sustained |
| `ACKNOWLEDGED` | Operator acknowledged; suppresses re-notification |
| `RESOLVED` | Condition cleared and held below threshold past hysteresis margin |
| `OFFLINE` | No readings within staleness window, or LWT fired |

### Events

`READING { value, ts }`, `ACK { operator }`, `RESOLVE`, `HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT`, `DEVICE_ONLINE`

### Guards

| Guard | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `isWarning(value)` | value >= warnThreshold and < critThreshold |
| `isCritical(value)` | value >= critThreshold |
| `isBackToNormal(value)` | value < (warnThreshold - hysteresisMargin) |
| `sustainedFor(n)` | Triggering condition held for n consecutive readings |
| `isStale(lastSeen)` | now - lastSeen > stalenessMs |
| `isActiveAlert()` | Current state is WARNING or CRITICAL |

### Transitions

| From | Event | Guard | To |
|---|---|---|---|
| NORMAL | READING | isWarning && sustainedFor(n) | WARNING |
| NORMAL | READING | isCritical && sustainedFor(n) | CRITICAL |
| WARNING | READING | isCritical && sustainedFor(n) | CRITICAL |
| WARNING | READING | isBackToNormal && sustainedFor(n) | NORMAL |
| CRITICAL | READING | !isCritical && isWarning | WARNING |
| WARNING or CRITICAL | ACK | isActiveAlert | ACKNOWLEDGED |
| ACKNOWLEDGED | READING | isCritical | CRITICAL |
| ACKNOWLEDGED | READING | isBackToNormal && sustainedFor(n) | RESOLVED |
| RESOLVED | READING | isBackToNormal | NORMAL |
| any | HEARTBEAT_TIMEOUT | isStale | OFFLINE |
| OFFLINE | DEVICE_ONLINE or READING | (none) | NORMAL |

## Event store

Append-only SQLite table. Domain rows are never UPDATEd or DELETEd.

Table: `events`

| Column | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `id` | Autoincrement, monotonic ordering |
| `aggregate_type` | e.g. `channel` |
| `aggregate_id` | e.g. `vehicle-7:coolantTemp` |
| `event_type` | `ReadingRecorded`, `AlertRaised`, `AlertEscalated`, `AlertAcknowledged`, `AlertResolved`, `DeviceWentOffline` |
| `payload` | JSON |
| `occurred_at` | Domain time (ISO string) |
| `recorded_at` | System time |
| `actor` | `system` or operator id |
| `correlation_id` | Ties a reading to the alert events it caused |
| `causation_id` | The event that directly caused this one |
| `hash` | sha256(prev_hash + canonical(payload)) |
| `prev_hash` | Hash of the preceding row (tamper-evidence hash chain) |

**Point-in-time reconstruction:** select all events for `aggregate_id` where `occurred_at <= T`, fold through the pure reducer in `alertMachine.js`, and you recover the exact historical state at time T. This powers the dashboard time-travel slider.

## Perfect Framework

| Concern | Evidence |
|---|---|
| Secrets management | `.env` (gitignored), `.env.example` committed, `src/config.js` reads `process.env` exclusively — no hardcoded secrets anywhere |
| Authentication | Koa middleware on `POST /api/command` (ACK/RESOLVE endpoints); every mutation requires `Authorization: Bearer <AUTH_TOKEN>` |
| Scalability | Stateless gateway and alert-engine workers; `docker-compose --scale gateway=2` works without code changes; state is event-sourced from SQLite on restart |
| Persistence | Append-only `events` table; full state is reconstructable by replay |
| Audit trail | Event store + SHA-256 hash chain + time-travel reconstruction via pure reducer |
| Deployment | Public HTTPS via ngrok tunnel; Caddyfile committed for VPS deployment |

## MQTT conventions

- **Broker:** mqtt.uvucs.org (port 1883 plain, 8883 TLS) — dev fallback: test.mosquitto.org:1883
- **Topic scheme:** `fleet/{vehicleId}/{metric}/clean`, `alerts/{vehicleId}/{metric}`
- **QoS 1** on alert and command topics (no silent drops)
- **Retained messages** on latest reading and alert state per topic
- **Last Will and Testament:** device-sim publishes LWT to `fleet/{vehicleId}/status` with `{"status":"offline"}`. The alert-engine drives the OFFLINE transition on receipt.
- **Stable clientId + cleanSession=false** on alert-engine and ws-bridge for production so reconnected subscribers resume their sessions.

## Running locally

### Prerequisites

- Node.js 20+
- An MQTT broker (mqtt.uvucs.org, or `docker run -p 1883:1883 eclipse-mosquitto`)
- Optional: Docker + docker-compose for the full stack

### Setup

```bash
cp .env.example .env
# edit .env: set MQTT_URL, AUTH_TOKEN, etc.
npm install
```

### Start each component in a separate terminal

```bash
# 1. device simulator
node src/device-sim/index.js

# 2. gateway
node src/gateway/index.js

# 3. alert engine
node src/alert-engine/index.js

# 4. ws-bridge + dashboard server
node src/ws-bridge/index.js
```

Open `http://localhost:3000` in a browser.

### Inject a CRITICAL spike for demo

```bash
node scripts/inject-spike.js          # vehicle-1 coolantTemp -> CRITICAL
node scripts/inject-spike.js clear    # back to NORMAL
```

### Run tests

```bash
npm test
```

71 tests across 6 files. Requires Node.js 20+ on the same OS the native `better-sqlite3` binary was compiled for.

### Docker

```bash
docker-compose up --build
```

## Environment variables

All variables are read from `.env` via `src/config.js`. See `.env.example` for the full list.

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `MQTT_URL` | `mqtt://mqtt.uvucs.org:1883` | Broker URL |
| `MQTT_USER` | (empty) | Broker username |
| `MQTT_PASS` | (empty) | Broker password |
| `AUTH_TOKEN` | `changeme` | Bearer token for ACK/RESOLVE commands |
| `SQLITE_PATH` | `./data/events.db` | Event store path |
| `WS_BRIDGE_PORT` | `3000` | HTTP + WS server port |
| `SUSTAINED_READINGS` | `3` | Consecutive readings required to change alert state |
| `HYSTERESIS_MARGIN` | `5` | Units below warning threshold before RESOLVED |
| `STALENESS_MS` | `30000` | Milliseconds before a channel is considered OFFLINE |
| `OLLAMA_URL` | `http://localhost:11434` | Ollama base URL (optional LLM summarizer) |
| `OLLAMA_MODEL` | `gpt-oss:120b` | Model name for summaries |
